knowledge:
- key_parameters: nominalPosition=FALSE ;; Specifies whether to incorporate positional ambiguity bounds (CIPOS and HOMPOS) into the GRanges breakend intervals. ;; selfPartnerSingleBreakends=TRUE ;; Parameter in partner() that treats the partner of a single breakend event as itself, preventing orphan creation during filtering. ;; maxgap=100 ;; Specifies the genomic distance margin allowed around call positions when matching breakpoints. ;; sizemargin=0.25 ;; Restricts the allowable size mismatch between matched events (e.g., 0.25 for 25% size difference). ;; restrictMarginToSizeMultiple=0.5 ;; Restricts the search margin based on a multiple of the event size to ensure simple events actually overlap. ;; countOnlyBest=TRUE ;; Prevents duplicate or highly similar calls from being double-counted against the truth set. ;; inferMissingBreakends=TRUE ;; Infers missing breakends for callers that do not output both sides of a breakpoint. ;; ignoreUnknownSymbolicAlleles=TRUE ;; Ignores symbolic alleles that are not recognized during parsing.
- alternatives: rtracklayer (Pairs object) ;; Used for loading BEDPE files, but uses a breakpoint-centric notation rather than the breakend-centric notation of StructuralVariantAnnotation.
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing structural variant calls from VCF files (e.g., from GRIDSS, Manta, DELLY, Pindel, BreakDancer) to perform downstream tasks like caller comparison, truth-set matching, transitive call identification, format conversion (BEDPE), or visualization (circos plots).
- pitfalls: Subsetting a breakpoint GRanges object can orphan breakends by filtering out their partners, which causes downstream functions like findBreakpointOverlaps() to fail. Use hasPartner() or selfPartnerSingleBreakends=TRUE to handle or filter these. ;; Standard overlap tools will fail to match small tandem duplications (<1000bp) reported as insertions by long-read callers and duplications by short-read callers; use findInsDupOverlaps() instead. ;; Transitive calls (e.g., complex rearrangements reported as a single direct breakpoint) can cause internal inconsistency and incorrect karyotype reconstructions; use findTransitiveCalls() to identify them.

workflows.name: sv_overlap_and_caller_comparison
workflows.intent: Load SV calls from multiple callers and compare them to a truth set to calculate precision and recall.
input: na12878_chr22_Sudmunt2015.vcf (VCF file containing truth set SVs)
workflows.stages: 1. Load VCF files using VariantAnnotation::readVcf ;; 2. Convert VCFs to breakend-centric GRanges using breakpointRanges ;; 3. Combine caller GRanges and calculate overlaps with the truth set using countBreakpointOverlaps with custom matching margins ;; 4. Calculate precision and recall metrics
workflows.code:
truth_vcf <- readVcf(system.file("extdata", "na12878_chr22_Sudmunt2015.vcf", package = "StructuralVariantAnnotation"))
truth_svgr <- breakpointRanges(truth_vcf)
truth_svgr <- truth_svgr[seqnames(truth_svgr) == "chr22"]
crest_vcf <- readVcf(system.file("extdata", "na12878_chr22_crest.vcf", package = "StructuralVariantAnnotation"))
VariantAnnotation::fixed(crest_vcf)$QUAL <- info(crest_vcf)$left_softclipped_read_count + info(crest_vcf)$left_softclipped_read_count
crest_svgr <- breakpointRanges(crest_vcf)
crest_svgr$caller <- "crest"
hydra_vcf <- readVcf(system.file("extdata", "na12878_chr22_hydra.vcf", package = "StructuralVariantAnnotation"))
hydra_svgr <- breakpointRanges(hydra_vcf)
hydra_svgr$caller <- "hydra"
svgr <- c(crest_svgr, hydra_svgr)
svgr$truth_matches <- countBreakpointOverlaps(svgr, truth_svgr,
  maxgap=100,
  sizemargin=0.25,
  restrictMarginToSizeMultiple=0.5,
  countOnlyBest=TRUE)

workflows.name: transitive_breakpoint_identification
workflows.intent: Identify transitive structural variant calls that can be explained by multiple other constituent breakpoints.
input: truthset_somaticSVs_COLO829.vcf (VCF file containing high-confidence somatic SVs)
colo829_nanoSV_truth_overlap.vcf (VCF file containing SV calls from long-read sequencing)
workflows.stages: 1. Load truth and query VCF files using readVcf ;; 2. Convert VCFs to GRanges using breakpointRanges, optionally inferring missing breakends ;; 3. Identify transitive calls using findTransitiveCalls
workflows.code:
colo829_truth_bpgr  <- breakpointRanges(readVcf(system.file("extdata", "truthset_somaticSVs_COLO829.vcf", package = "StructuralVariantAnnotation")))
colo829_nanosv_bpgr <- breakpointRanges(readVcf(system.file("extdata", "colo829_nanoSV_truth_overlap.vcf", package = "StructuralVariantAnnotation")), inferMissingBreakends=TRUE, ignoreUnknownSymbolicAlleles=TRUE)
findTransitiveCalls(colo829_nanosv_bpgr, colo829_truth_bpgr)

workflows.name: format_conversion_and_visualization
workflows.intent: Convert breakpoint GRanges to BEDPE format and visualize them using a circos plot.
input: gridss.vcf (VCF file containing structural variant calls)
COLO829T.purple.sv.ann.vcf.gz (VCF file containing annotated SV calls)
workflows.stages: 1. Load VCF and convert to GRanges using breakpointRanges ;; 2. Convert GRanges to Pairs and export to BEDPE using breakpointgr2pairs and rtracklayer::export ;; 3. Import BEDPE back to GRanges using pairs2breakpointgr and rtracklayer::import ;; 4. Prepare GRanges for circos plotting by adding a partner destination column ;; 5. Plot using ggbio and circle
workflows.code:
vcf <- VariantAnnotation::readVcf(system.file("extdata", "gridss.vcf", package = "StructuralVariantAnnotation"))
gr <- breakpointRanges(vcf)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(require(rtracklayer))
rtracklayer::export(breakpointgr2pairs(gr), con="example.bedpe")
bedpe.gr  <- pairs2breakpointgr(rtracklayer::import("example.bedpe"))
colo829_vcf <- VariantAnnotation::readVcf(system.file("extdata", "COLO829T.purple.sv.ann.vcf.gz", package = "StructuralVariantAnnotation"))
colo829_bpgr <- breakpointRanges(colo829_vcf)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(require(ggbio))
gr.circos <- colo829_bpgr[seqnames(colo829_bpgr) %in% seqlevels(biovizBase::hg19sub)]
seqlevels(gr.circos) <- seqlevels(biovizBase::hg19sub)
mcols(gr.circos)$to.gr <- granges(partner(gr.circos))
p <- ggbio() +
	circle(gr.circos, geom="link", linked.to="to.gr") +
	circle(biovizBase::hg19sub, geom='ideo', fill='gray70') +
	circle(biovizBase::hg19sub, geom='scale', size=2) +
	circle(biovizBase::hg19sub, geom='text', aes(label=seqnames), vjust=0, size=3)
p
